text:
Ana Partnerships: Kickoff: we should build a compact reference-patterns repo + Terraform quickstarts for partner onramp labs (marketplace + self-hosted). Need owners, minimal QA checklist, and a clear packaging path. Who can volunteer?
Devon Partnerships: I can co-own. Target Q3 release.
Sam Eng: I'll take terraform modules + CI tests. Planning to cover aws/gcp/azure. :thumbsup:
Lina Arch: I'll draft the network diagrams (VPC, peering, KMS flows) and a 1-page ops runbook for Dedicated/Private.
Chris AWS-Bizdev: Pinged cloud partner PMs. Ideally a single bundle mapping to marketplace assets + quickstart. Ill confirm artifact rules.
Sam Eng: Module plan: modules/compute (VM/GKE/VMSS), modules/network (VPC/subnets/peering), modules/iam (roles/policies). CI: terraform validate + tflint + terratest smoke. Example: `go test ./test -run TestSmoke -v`.
Ana Partnerships: Suggested QA checklist:
- \u2705 module docs + inputs/outputs
- \u2705 example overlay per cloud
- \u2705 license + third-party notices
- \u2705 security review (secret handling, KMS)
- \u2705 marketplace packaging notes
Devon Partnerships: Add a minimal e2e: deploy quickstart into sandbox account and check health endpoint.
Lina Arch: OK to include both marketplace flow and private/onprem flow in the diagrams? I'll make a side-by-side.
Chris AWS-Bizdev: Yes. Marketplace needs AMI/container sizing guidance, instance family recommendations (graviton/x86), and storage perf notes.
Sam Eng: Base docker image for quickstart + config toggle for quantized artifacts (no heavy artifacts in quickstart). Lock terraform to 1.5.x and pin provider constraints.
Ana Partnerships: Action items and deadlines:
- Sam: terraform modules + CI -> PR by 2024-09-06
- Lina: diagrams + ops runbook -> draft 2024-09-03
- Chris: confirm marketplace artifact requirements -> 2024-08-30
- Devon: owner for sample apps + marketing quickstart -> Devon volunteering
Sam Eng: repo skeleton created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/onramp-ref-patterns (private)
marketplace-bot: Repository created: redwood/onramp-ref-patterns by sam-eng
Devon Partnerships: I'll produce 3 sample apps (hosted-api, dedicated-deploy, onprem-compose) with short READMEs.
Ana Partnerships: Add minimal cost/perf notes per pattern to help partner conversations.
Lina Arch: Will add a small table for expected throughput and recommended instance types.
Sam Eng: I'll include a tiny terraform snippet in README and push CI scaffolding now. Example:
```
module "redwood_compute" {
  source = "git::https://git.internal/r/redwood/onramp-ref-patterns//modules/compute"
  cloud  = "aws"
  instance_type = "m6i.large"
}
```
Devon Partnerships: Propose 2-week cadence for checkins until GA. Next sync Wed 10am PT.
Ana Partnerships: Calendar invite + agenda (owners, blockers, publish checklist) incoming. If partner-specific legal constraints appear, tag @Legal-Review.
Legal-Review Bot: Noted. Attach contracts for review when ready.
Ana Partnerships: Closing for nowwill reconvene next Wed. :pray:
